reviews_captured_by_me.text: We had a fantastic experience working with Ciro and his team. From the start, Ciro was very friendly, professional, and fair with pricing. He was very efficient to communicate with and I felt our bathroom was in great hands! His team was speedy and professional - Francisco did an excellent job with our tile work! We had a large block window in our shower to work around, and he centered everything perfectly. As an engineer  with a picky taste, I was so impressed with the attention to detail and speed of their work. They were right on schedule and I felt like we couldn’t have had a better team to bring our bathroom to life! Would HIGHLY recommend!

CK Tile is a great locally owned company. Ciro went above and beyond. He arranged for tile pickup, plumber, ceiling resurfacing, leveled the floor, and installed the tile. He was very patient with all my questions.
Last pics are prior to remodel.
